n146801bf07.headline: Four-Fifths of Companies Have Yet to Publish Results, Information Obligation Must Be Fulfilled by Year-End | Aktuálně.cz
n146801bf07.summary: About 80% of companies in the Czech Republic have not submitted their 2015 financial statements, though they have until year-end to comply with legal requirements.
n146801bf07.why: Timely financial disclosures are essential for market transparency and investor decision-making in the Czech market.
